preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= n <= 100 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after t is an integer n (3 ≤ n ≤ 100) representing the number of elements in the sequences.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == len(b) == len(c) == n for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]] for a, b, c in zip(stdin.splitlines()[2::2], stdin.splitlines()[3::2], stdin.splitlines()[4::2]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the next three lines contain n integers each, representing sequences a, b, and c respectively.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2] for x in line.split()) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[3::2] for x in line.split()) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[4::2] for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: All elements in sequences a, b, and c are integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i != b_i and a_i != c_i and b_i != c_i for a_i, b_i, c_i in zip(map(int, line_a.split()), map(int, line_b.split()), map(int, line_c.split())))
preconditions.description: For each i, a_i ≠ b_i, a_i ≠ c_i, and b_i ≠ c_i, where line_a, line_b, and line_c are the respective lines for a, b, and c in each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(p) == n for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]] for p in [line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly n integers, where n is the number of elements in the sequences.

postconditions.expression: all(p_i in {a_i, b_i, c_i} for a_i, b_i, c_i, p_i in zip(map(int, line_a.split()), map(int, line_b.split()), map(int, line_c.split()), map(int, p.split())))
postconditions.description: For each element p_i in the output sequence, p_i must be one of {a_i, b_i, c_i} for the corresponding i.

postconditions.expression: all(p_i != p_j for i, j in [(k, (k + 1) % n) for k in range(n)] for p in [line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()] for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]] for p_i, p_j in zip(map(int, p), map(int, p)) if i < n and j == (i + 1) % n)
postconditions.description: For each test case, no two adjacent elements in the output sequence p are equal, where adjacency includes the circular condition (p_n ≠ p_1).
